style: 16-bit pixel art game art, crisp hard-edged pixels, limited night palette: plum black, deep plum, violet glow, cream, sunset orange, warm orange and gold window lights, the career accent colour only on screens and small glows. Dusk City at night: a skyline made of lit window dots, a few still stars
suffix: no people, no faces, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no sunburst rays, no perspective floor grid, no scanlines, no grain, no glowing particles

assets.prompt: a giant cute round bear-shaped balloon floating above the glowing entrance of a big shopping mall at night, a long empty queue of rope barriers snaking toward the mall doors, a small empty stage with one soft pink spotlight, no brand logos

a small Thai street toast stall with a striped awning in front of a closed school gate at night, golden toast slices and jars of spreads on the counter, a tablet propped on the counter showing a simple pink bar chart going up, three blank paper flyers pinned to the stall

an open orange portfolio folder on a desk at night holding small marketing work: a mini poster mockup of abstract shapes, a card with a pink pie chart, a printed photo of a small shop front, a warm desk lamp, a cream university gate on a far hill through the window

a study desk at night under a warm desk lamp, an open notebook with a one-page plan drawn as abstract wavy lines and a tiny sketch of a shop front, three blank pink sticky notes shaped like speech bubbles beside it, a pencil, the moon and a small lit shop across the street in the window, a small orange flag on the desk

a rooftop at the edge of the city just before sunrise, a big blank billboard on the rooftop with a plain glowing pink panel, a megaphone resting on the ledge pointing toward a thin orange band of first light on the horizon, a path of glowing tiles leading to the ledge
a vertical top-down game world map at night: five small dark islands in a deep plum sea, tiny lit windows on each island, no path, no labels
a chunky pixel picture frame, pink outer border, orange corner studs, deep plum dithered interior with a few stars, empty centre
